description: Add audience segments (e.g. past buyers) as EXCLUDE targeting on an ad squad, keeping existing targeting. Previews unless confirm=true. For several items at once pass adsquad_ids instead of the single id: Add the same buyer-exclusion audiences to up to 20 ad squads. Per-item preview (skips squads that already exclude them); stops at the first failure. Previews unless confirm=true. Use to keep chosen audiences (for example past buyers) from seeing one ad squad's ads. For several ad squads pass adsquad_ids instead of adsquad_id.

adsquad_id.description: Ad squad id. Get it from snap_list_adsquads.

adsquad_ids.description: Ad squad ids. Get them from snap_list_adsquads.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

segment_ids.description: Audience (segment) ids. Get them from snap_list_segments.

name: snap_exclude_segments
